title: Tapas, catamaran, and a night out in Barcelona
text: A very complete plan to enjoy Barcelona in a different way. The catamaran ride with the tapas and the views of the city from the sea is a great combination. Also, the free pass to a nightclub is a nice touch for those who want to continue enjoying the night after the cruise. An original proposal to do with friends.
author: O2688BKjulietted

title: A different and very entertaining plan
text: We took the catamaran tour and we liked the experience a lot. The atmosphere during the sailing was very pleasant and being able to see Barcelona from the sea gives it a special touch. The combination of the tour, the stop to swim, and the tapas makes it a quite complete activity. We had a great time and it felt too short for us.
author: M4232HGalbas

title: A very pleasant walk along the coast of Barcelona
text: We really enjoyed the catamaran trip. The atmosphere was calm and fun, with music, tapas, and drinks while we contemplated Barcelona from the sea. A different experience to have a good time and enjoy the views.
author: josepg739

title: A great way to enjoy Barcelona from the sea
text: We loved the catamaran experience. The atmosphere was very pleasant, with music, good views of the Barcelona coast, and time to swim in the sea. The tapas and drinks rounded out the plan very well. A different and fun activity to spend a few hours in Barcelona.
author: Z1425OMisabela

title: A very complete experience in Barcelona.
text: We did the Barcelona Catamaran Cruise with Swim, Tapas & FREE Pass NightClub experience and we enjoyed the plan a lot. The catamaran ride was very pleasant, with good views of Barcelona from the sea and a lively atmosphere on board. The stop to swim was one of the best moments and the tapas complemented the experience very well. A different and entertaining activity to enjoy Barcelona from another perspective.
author: 891jaumem
